Priya (Finance): FYI - discovered EXPQ2 promo auto-applied to a Dedicated customer invoice (INV-99211). This promo was meant for hosted free-tier only. @Ava @Marco pls advise.
BillingBot: Rule triggered: EXPQ2-PROMO applied to INV-99211 by rule 'exp-auto-rollout' (rule id: exp-0426).
Ava (Customer Success): Reached out to the customer. They prefer a credit on next invoice rather than refund.
Marco (Accounting): We can post a manual credit memo for $750 and link to next invoice INV-99242. Need finance approval and GL code.
Liam (Sales): Also note: customer is in a committed Dedicated plan, promo shouldn't apply. Flagging for Product to fix cohort filters.
Priya (Finance): Approve rollforward as goodwill credit. Use GL 5230-promos. Add audit note: "misapplied by exp-0426".
Marco (Accounting): Creating credit memo CM-7012. Will post $750 to Acct and link to INV-99242.
BillingBot: Credit memo CM-7012 queued. Status: pending apply on next billing run.
Ava (Customer Success): I'll send a short confirmation to the customer: "We've moved the $750 promo to your May invoice as a goodwill credit; no action needed on the original invoice."
Priya (Finance): Opening ticket for experiments team: EXP-FIX-842 to restrict experiment rollout to non-committed accounts.
Marco (Accounting): CM-7012 posted and attached to customer account. Audit log updated on INV-99211.
BillingBot: Credit applied in system. Thread closed.
